g.text: PR #2400 · Acknowledged Claude effort controls
Claude effort stayed hidden because its driver discarded overrides.
Typed settings acknowledgements now gate prompts, so the picker can safely return.
BEFORE
AFTER
supported_reasoning_effort
Only Codex receives composer effort overrides.
Claude picker stays hidden to avoid a false control.
IoCommand::UserInput
reasoning_effort is discarded by the Claude driver.
No settings request precedes the user prompt.
Claude composer state
CLI-reported effort is not shown in the composer.
Old drivers provide no effort-control capability.
ClaudeEffortCapability / ClaudeEffortStatus
New drivers enable controls on init; old drivers stay hidden.
Reported effort is shown; ultrathink gates XHigh.
EffortController
Typed apply_flag_settings; one pending prompt, 10s bound.
Only its matching success ACK releases the user input.
Auto / InputAck.rejected_seq
Auto null-clears flags; rejection removes one queue row.
Unknown delivery stays replayable; XHigh follows native init.
Old backends ignore rejected_seq; use a current backend. Lost rejection frames retain existing at-least-once delivery limits.
